content.text: Oracle Database is the industry-leading enterprise relational database, powering mission-critical workloads with extreme availability, advanced diagnostics, and comprehensive tooling.

items: Oracle Database — PL/SQL, RAC, Data Guard, flashback technology, AWR/ASH diagnostics, and partitioning
Performance Diagnostics — AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Tuning Advisor, execution plans, optimizer hints, and wait events
High Availability — RAC architecture, Data Guard (physical/logical standby), switchover/failover, and GoldenGate replication
